work.name: IKEA North America Services, LLC
highlights: Co-owned the fragment and PIP ownership transition to Buy; built and owned server- and client-rendered microfrontends on IKEA's edge-rendering platform (Dynamic Web Framework and Edge Variant Service), leading translations, SSR availability loading, and CI/CD work across Buy and Navigation

Managed edge caching, request context, and production/test deployments for independently delivered fragments across Cloudflare Workers, resolving cross-fragment state, server-side rendering, and pub/sub integration issues
Co-designed the Buy monorepo migration CLI and CI/CD pattern, consolidating 52 per-market production deployments into one deployment per release and driving adoption by the Navigation team

Diagnosed and fixed geolocation reliability and data-integrity issues, including an 11% reduction so far in Google Geocoding API cost, a customer-visible validation regression affecting 27 markets, and cross-user server-side rendering state leakage

Drove development of Vaka, a greenfield real-time observability platform built with Fastly, Dynamic Web Framework, Preact, GCP, and MongoDB that enhanced error resolution in customer-facing online shopping systems and significantly reduced Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR)

Modernized Checkout and Buy foundations through ESLint 9, Node, OpenTelemetry, dependency governance, security, and TypeScript upgrades across several repositories; mentored an engineer new to web development through a personalized plan spanning HTML/CSS, TypeScript, React, and AI-assisted tooling
